section_summary.extract_value: This section describes 'The Present Study', which aimed to examine the factor structure and construct/discriminant validity of the K-DOCS using two large adult samples from Amazon MTurk and Poland. In the Polish sample, the study also investigated the K-DOCS' relationship with other constructs, including the CAQ and intelligence, and explored the existence of latent profiles with the K-DOCS.
